title: Senior Account Executive II
description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

 Join Collibra’s Sales team as a Senior Account Executive II, Enterprise - East Coast

 Make an impact at Collibra by fueling Collibra’s growth in your assigned East Coast territory and be the guiding force behind bringing Collibra’s value and vision to customers and prospects. As part of our Enterprise Sales team, you will be a relentless hunter — opening new doors, building pipelines from scratch, and driving net new revenue across some of the most exciting enterprise accounts on the East Coast. This is a role for someone who thrives in a greenfield environment and is energized by the challenge of finding and closing new business.

 Senior Account Executives at Collibra are responsible for

• Aggressively prospecting and hunting for net new accounts, building pipeline from the ground up through disciplined outbound activity, executive outreach, and creative prospecting strategies

• Managing and creating demand for expansion on existing customers to widen the footprint of Collibra within accounts

• Owning complex deal cycles end to end — from lead origination and stakeholder mapping through negotiation, close, and expansion

• Successfully collaborating with customers, partners, and peers in a consultative sales process where you will identify value and ROI to support customer needs

• Maintaining reliable, accurate forecasting with Salesforce updates reflective of real-time activity

 You have

• A proven hunter mentality — you have built pipeline from zero, opened cold accounts, and closed net new logos consistently throughout your career

• Consistently achieved or overachieved your SaaS sales quota — President’s Club or equivalent recognition is a strong signal

• Experience in the Data Management domain highly preferred

• 6+ years in new business and account management SaaS/tech sales with a clear emphasis on net new logo acquisition

• Originated and navigated complex, direct sales cycles with multiple technical and business stakeholders

• Sold net new business and expansion opportunities to C-level buyers in large enterprise accounts

• Managed consultative sales processes with value-based impacts or outcomes

• At least 2 to 3 years of experience in data management sales familiar with corresponding sales methodologies and comprehensible track records

• Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, or Copilot to drive measurable outcomes, streamline workflows, and accelerate pipeline generation

• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent related working experience

• This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship

 You are

• A grinder — someone who acts with urgency, holds themselves accountable, and does not wait to be handed opportunities

• Known for your integrity and commitment to the customer

• Composed, resourceful, and focused in high-growth and ambiguous environments

• Comfortable with significant travel within your East Coast territory to build relationships and close business face to face

• Adaptive, accountable, and execution-oriented

• A precise communicator and persuasive negotiator who knows how to close

• Proud of your work and always aiming for excellence

 Measures of success

• Within your first month you have completed onboarding and connected with your team members and functional peers

• Within your third month you are actively building a pipeline of net new business in your assigned East Coast territory

• Within your sixth month you have a solid foundation of prospective clients and are driving opportunities toward close

 Compensation for this role

 The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 to $175,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors including but not limited to experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.
 Benefits at Collibra

 Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits .

 We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

 At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.

 With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Credit Risk Manager, Portfolio Management
description:
We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London or Remote (UK) | £100,000 - £130,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +  Benefits | Data Team, Borrowing 

About the team:

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.

With our Flex product we’re reinventing credit cards to give customers more visibility and control over their spending. With our Flex product, we’re reinventing credit cards to give customers more visibility and control over their spending. Flex portfolio management is currently in its infancy—meaning this role is a true "zero-to-one" blank canvas. Flex behaves differently from a standard credit card, so we are looking for a highly strategic Credit Risk Manager who can challenge legacy banking assumptions, think from first principles, and put the customer at the heart of our lifecycle strategies.

You will lead an initial team of 3 credit analysts (with scope to grow the team over time) to unlock massive P&L and customer engagement potential on a rapidly growing portfolio. While the immediate focus is scaling safely in the UK, you will help lay the groundwork for a global footprint as Monzo expands into Europe.

Our credit teams are part of our Data Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.

Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.

Your day-to-day:

  • Own Portfolio Monitoring & Forecasting: Build and oversee robust performance frameworks to monitor and forecast both risk and revenue metrics, ensuring our rapidly growing portfolio scales sustainably.
  • Drive Contractual Pricing Strategies: Architect and optimise an ongoing risk-based pricing program that balances commercial viability and fair customer outcomes.
  • Fuel Engagement & Retention Loops: Design and deploy sophisticated credit strategies for lifecycle events, including product upgrades, engagement incentives, and balance transfer propositions that deepen customer loyalty.
  • Execute Data-Driven Loss Mitigation: Develop proactive risk management frameworks—such as credit limit decrease strategies—to safely mitigate losses and support financially vulnerable customers.
  • Lead and Nurture Talent: Manage, coach, and scale a high-performing team of 3 credit analysts, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and strong commercial focus.
  • Cross-Functional Squad Collaboration: Act as the embedded credit risk expert within a multi-disciplinary squad, working side-by-side with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Customer Research, and Risk & Control.
  • Cross-functional Leadership: Build deep collaborative ties with wider credit functions and manage relationships with 2nd Line Credit Risk, Legal, and Compliance, while translating complex data into clear narratives for executive-level stakeholders.

How we work:

Our main tech hub is in London, but our data teams are based all over the UK — from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We love meeting in person, but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you’re nearby. You’ll do your best work where you feel most comfortable.

We value flexibility, connection, and wellbeing. You’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life, whether that’s school drop-offs, avoiding rush hour, or making time for what matters most.

Work the way that works for you at Monzo!

You should apply if:

What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!

  • You are a commercial, strategic credit leader with a deep understanding of unsecured lending portfolios—ideally with exposure to credit card lifecycle management.
  • You thrive in ambiguous, "zero-to-one" environments. You love building strategies from scratch, questioning traditional banking norms, and working at pace.
  • You have portfolio management experience, including risk-based pricing, retention, product upgrades, and loss mitigation strategies.
  • You are a champion for both Credit and Conduct Risk. You naturally balance sharp credit instincts with a passion for protecting customers and delivering delightful experiences.
  • You are an exceptional stakeholder manager and storyteller. You can smoothly collaborate with engineering squads, align with legal and compliance partners, and influence up to executive leadership.
  • You love developing people. You have a proven track record of leading analytical talent and are energized by the prospect of managing and growing a high-impact team.
  • You have strong technical and data capabilities. You are comfortable digging into data yourself and driving a data-first culture (SQL is a must-have; Python and Looker experience is a plus).

The Interview Process:

Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!

  • Recruiter call 
  • Initial call with the hiring manager 
  • Final loop of interviews meeting the team

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. 

What’s in it for you:

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK 

✅ We can sponsor visas

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

#LI-COD #LI-REMOTE

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage

title: Teacher of Mathematics
location: Bishop's Stortford, East of England, GB
description:
Hockerill Anglo-European College is a thriving, diverse and forward-thinking state boarding school with a proud international ethos. As an IB World School, we are committed to developing inquiring, knowledgeable and open-minded young people who are equipped to make a positive contribution to the world around them. Alongside GCSEs, we offer the International Baccalaureate Middle Years and Diploma Programmes and, from September 2027, will broaden our post-16 provision to include A Levels, ensuring that every student can follow the pathway best suited to their strengths, aspirations and future plans.

Mathematics is a highly valued subject within the College and plays a central role in our strong academic tradition. We are seeking an enthusiastic and talented Teacher of Mathematics to join our successful and supportive department. The successful candidate will be passionate about their subject, committed to delivering outstanding teaching and learning, and able to inspire, challenge and motivate students across all key stages.

This is an exciting opportunity for either an experienced teacher or an Early Career Teacher to join a collaborative department with a strong record of academic success. For suitably qualified and experienced candidates, there may be the opportunity to undertake additional responsibilities, with appropriate remuneration, subject to experience and the needs of the College.

As a thriving boarding and international community, Hockerill offers a rich and varied educational experience extending well beyond the classroom. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute fully to the wider life of the College through enrichment activities, trips, exchanges and the extensive co-curricular programme for which Hockerill is renowned.

We are committed to supporting the professional development of our staff and offer a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement and high aspirations. Whether you are at the beginning of your teaching career or looking for your next challenge, this role offers an excellent opportunity to develop professionally within a successful and highly respected school.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK, as we are unable to provide visa sponsorship.

Early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to interview and appoint prior to the closing date should a suitable candidate be identified.We are committed to providing students with a rich variety of opportunities beyond the classroom, and the successful candidate will be expected to contribute to this by supporting our existing extra-curricular programme or by introducing new activities that further enhance its breadth and impact.

Hockerill is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All appointments are subject to satisfactory pre-employment checks, including an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check and barred list check where appropriate.

We strive to be an inclusive and diverse workplace that reflects the diversity of our student population. Applications from Black, Asian and minority ethnic candidates are particularly welcome.

description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

 Our Mission:

 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

 Our People:

 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

 IT Support Specialist

 About the Role

 6sense is looking for an IT Support Specialist who is passionate about delivering exceptional employee experiences through world-class IT support. This role combines hands-on end user support with administration of modern workplace technologies, identity systems, SaaS applications, endpoint management, and AI platforms.

 You'll support a global workforce while helping improve IT operations through automation, documentation, and process improvement. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and creating scalable solutions that make employees more productive.

 What You'll Do

• Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 support through tickets, chat, email, and remote support sessions.

• Support macOS, Windows 11, Microsoft 365, Teams, Slack, and Zoom environments.

• Manage user lifecycle processes including onboarding, offboarding, access requests, and role changes.

• Administer and troubleshoot Okta, Entra ID, SSO, MFA, and identity-related services.

• Support and manage SaaS platforms including Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, 1Password, GitHub, Claude Enterprise, and Workato.

• Deploy, configure, and maintain endpoints using Intune, Iru, and CrowdStrike.

• Maintain accurate asset inventory and device lifecycle management.

• Support Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and other AI technologies while promoting responsible AI practices.

• Develop scripts, automations, and workflow improvements that reduce manual effort and improve efficiency.

• Create and maintain documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures.

• Provide occasional support for Zoom Rooms, Teams meetings, executive users, and company events.

 What We're Looking For

• 3+ years of experience in IT Support, Help Desk, Service Desk, or End User Computing.

• Experience supporting macOS and Windows environments.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Teams, Slack, and Zoom.

• Familiarity with identity and access management concepts including Okta, Entra ID, SSO, and MFA.

• Experience with endpoint management tools such as Intune, Iru, or similar MDM platforms.

• Strong troubleshooting, communication, and customer service skills.

• Experience working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

• Basic scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, Workato, or similar tools.

• Interest in AI technologies such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude.

• Strong attention to detail, ownership, and a continuous improvement mindset.

 Bonus Points

• Experience administering Okta, Entra ID, Intune, or Iru.

• Experience with Workato or workflow automation platforms.

• Experience supporting AI platforms and governance practices.

• ITIL, Okta, Microsoft, Apple, or security-related certifications.

• Experience supporting executive stakeholders and globally distributed teams.

 Success in This Role

 You'll thrive in this role if you're customer-obsessed, highly organized, technically curious, and motivated to improve how IT services are delivered. Success will be measured through service quality, SLA performance, knowledge sharing, asset management accuracy, and contributions to automation and process improvement.

description:

 URL: https://www.apollo.io/es

 About the Role

 Apollo is hiring a Business Recruiter to own full-cycle recruiting across our G&A, Sales and Marketing organizations . This is a high-ownership role on a lean, high-performing team. You will manage a portfolio of mid and senior-level requisitions, build and execute sourcing strategies, and serve as a genuine business partner to your hiring managers. This role requires someone who operates with low oversight , self-diagnoses problems before they escalate , and brings a talent advisor posture to every stakeholder conversation. The best person for this role brings their own operating system and makes the team around them sharper.

 What You Will Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting for mid and senior-level roles across G&A, Sales and Marketing, with consistent delivery across multiple verticals simultaneously

• Build and execute sourcing strategies that generate qualified, diverse pipelines, and adapt those strategies based on funnel performance , not just instinct

• Conduct structured screens and interviews, design interview plans , and lead calibrated debriefs that result in clear, defensible hiring decisions

• Manage 20+ phone screens per week and drive 360+ outbound contacts per quarter

• Hold the bar on candidate quality , give direct and honest feedback, and avoid passing weak profiles to sidestep an uncomfortable conversation

• Maintain accurate, real-time pipeline data in Greenhouse and self-report on progress to leadership without being asked

• Track funnel metrics, identify root causes of slowdowns, and bring data-informed recommendations to stakeholder conversations

• Partner with hiring managers and business leaders as a talent advisor : shape role scoping, set expectations on candidate profiles, and influence as a subject matter expert.

• Work cross-functionally with Finance, HR, and Compensation to navigate offer approvals and headcount processes with operational integrity

• Build or improve multiple workflows, processes, or tools that create efficiency beyond your own req load

 What We Are Looking For

• 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a focus on Sales, Revenue, or Marketing roles in SaaS

• Demonstrated delivery in high-growth environments where you managed complexity and ambiguity

• Comfort and credibility working with stakeholders at all levels, including the ability to challenge and influence , not just execute

• Strong data fluency : you monitor your own funnel health, diagnose issues before they surface in a check-in, and use data to drive stakeholder conversations

• Proven AI and process efficiency capability : you have built repeatable workflows or automation that measurably improved your output, and you can speak to what you built, why it works, and what changed

• Familiarity with Revenue teams, high-performing marketing orgs, and product-led growth models

• Hands-on experience with Greenhouse and Gem , with clean data hygiene as a non-negotiable operating habit

• Clear, direct communicator who can influence without authority across functions

• High agency : you identify problems, generate solutions, and drive progress without waiting for direction

title: Fraud Analyst
location: Denmark,  Germany,  Portugal,  Spain,  Sweden,  UK
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We are looking for a Fraud Analyst to join Pleo’s Decision Intelligence team and help strengthen how we detect, prevent, monitor, and respond to fraud risk across our financial crime decisioning setup.

This is not a traditional Fraud Operations case-handling role. You will work closer to the decisioning layer: helping translate fraud patterns into rules, monitoring rule performance, supporting rule testing, reviewing alert behaviour, and making sure fraud controls remain effective, explainable, and proportionate.

You will join at an important stage as Pleo continues to mature its fraud and AML decisioning capability. The right person will help improve speed, resilience, and quality in how we create, test, deploy, monitor, and tune fraud rules.

What you’ll be doing

You will help operate and improve Pleo’s fraud decisioning capability, with a focus on card fraud and related financial crime risk scenarios.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the end-to-end fraud rule lifecycle: from rule proposal and analysis through testing, deployment, monitoring, tuning, and rollback.

  • Working directly in, or closely with, decisioning tools and rule engines to support fraud detection logic.

  • Analysing fraud patterns, alert trends, false positives, false negatives, and rule performance.

  • Translating FraudOps insights and stakeholder requests into clear, structured rule proposals.

  • Helping assess whether new rules or threshold changes are justified by data.

  • Monitoring post-deployment rule performance and identifying when rules need adjustment.

  • Supporting daily operational requests related to fraud controls, while ensuring changes are traceable and well documented.

  • Partnering with FraudOps, AML, Product, Engineering, Data, Compliance, and Legal to make sure decisioning changes are aligned and risk-aware.

  • Maintaining clear documentation for fraud rules, rationale, expected impact, testing outcomes, and monitoring results.

  • Helping reduce single points of failure by building repeatable processes and stronger business continuity around fraud decisioning.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for someone who combines fraud domain knowledge with practical experience working in a decisioning environment.

You should have:

  • Experience as a Fraud Analyst, Risk Analyst, Fraud Strategy Analyst, Fraud Rules Analyst, Decisioning Analyst, or similar.

  • Hands-on experience with a decisioning tool, fraud rules engine, risk platform, or internal decisioning system.

  • Experience creating, testing, monitoring, or tuning fraud rules, thresholds, scenarios, or risk logic.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data to assess rule performance and fraud patterns.

  • Good understanding of fraud typologies, especially card fraud, transaction fraud, account misuse, or payment fraud.

  • Ability to balance fraud prevention with customer impact and operational workload.

  • Experience working with false positives and understanding that good fraud controls require continuous monitoring and tuning.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain rule logic, rationale, risks, and expected outcomes clearly.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with FraudOps, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Data teams.

  • A structured mindset and appreciation for documentation, traceability, governance, and change control.

  • Fintech, banking, payments, spend management, or regulated financial services.

  • SQL or basic data analysis.

What success looks like

In your first 3 months, success would look like:

  • You understand Pleo’s fraud decisioning setup and can confidently support day-to-day rule operations.

  • Fraud rule requests are better structured, documented, and traceable.

  • Rule changes are supported by data, clear rationale, and expected impact.

  • Post-deployment monitoring is more consistent and visible.

  • FraudOps and DI have a stronger operating rhythm for proposing, reviewing, deploying, and tuning fraud controls.

Why join us?

This is a rare opportunity to help shape a growing decisioning function from the inside. You will not just be reviewing fraud alerts, you will help define how fraud detection logic is built, governed, monitored, and improved.

title: Backend Engineer (Python),AI Engineering: Agent Foundations
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer (Python) in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers the reusable building blocks agents and flows are made from as well as our core harness, Duo Developer.

Most of your work will be backend engineering in Python, using libraries such as LangGraph to build secure, reliable and scalable features in our AI Gateway. You'll also work across the stack where needed. You'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.

What you'll do

  • Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the Duo Workflow Service, the AI Gateway and, where needed, the GitLab monolith. Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.
  • Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry.
  • Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.
  • Design, implement and review APIs (including GraphQL and REST) and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients such as the GitLab monolith, IDE extensions and Duo CLI.
  • Improve and extend automated testing (pytest and other frameworks), including evaluations of agent and flow behavior, to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.
  • Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.
  • Join Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.
  • Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class as more work becomes agentic.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and maintaining production Python backend applications, including APIs, asynchronous or background processing, and data models.
  • Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangGraph, or designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or harnesses.
  • Skill in designing or extending APIs (REST, GraphQL or gRPC) with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.
  • Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Ruby on Rails and/or JavaScript and Vue is a plus.
  • Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.
  • Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.

About the team

The Agent Foundations stage builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution. Between them, they own the GitLab Duo Developer foundational flow and the Flow Registry; the AI Catalog, including custom agents, custom flows and external agent integrations; and agent execution, agent tools and agent observability.

Our engineers work async-first across EMEA, AMER, and India timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features.

An overview of this role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Repository Management team within GitLab's Source Code stage. You'll help customers configure repositories with confidence so their GitLab projects support the way their teams work. As artificial intelligence agents increasingly write and manage code alongside people, you'll build guardrails that make development safe and trustworthy. You'll turn complex policy and repository management needs into reliable backend solutions that support people and the agents working on their behalf.

You'll work in one of GitLab's oldest and most complex product areas, using Ruby and GraphQL to improve a critical system that serves GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. Source Code provides the interface layer, through Gitaly, to the Git repositories that account for a large portion of GitLab traffic. With support from experienced team members, you'll help maintain high reliability through performance and structured query language tuning, caching, rate limiting, testing, observability, and resiliency. You'll collaborate with product management, product design, testing, security, user experience research, technical writing, Gitaly, Code Review, and Source Code Experience to deliver reliable and performant systems.

Learn more about the Create:Source Code teams in the GitLab Handbook.

What you’ll do

  • Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby and GraphQL.
  • Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system.
  • Contribute to backend services, application programming interfaces, data models, and business logic for repository management.
  • Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, involving domain experts and seeking guidance when needed.
  • Use artificial intelligence agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output.
  • Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and apply feedback from code review.
  • Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency.
  • Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.

What you’ll bring

  • Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL or the ability to learn them.
  • An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.
  • Experience contributing to policy, permissions, or rules-based features in web applications and helping make that complexity reliable and maintainable.
  • Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with Git and collaborative code review processes.
  • Experience using artificial intelligence coding tools or agents, with the ability to review their output and recognize when additional guidance is needed.
  • Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates and collaborating in a remote, asynchronous environment.
  • The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance for decisions that are difficult to reverse.

The functional team works across Europe and North America, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous collaboration. It includes six engineers, and this role offers an opportunity to grow your backend skills, learn from experienced team members, and contribute to our technical direction. We work closely with Code Review and Gitaly, alongside sibling teams covering Repository Sync & Interop, Source Code Experience, and Repository Scale, Performance & Git Infrastructure. We're maturing GitLab's branch protection offering while maintaining availability, reliability, and stability through bug fixes and focused technical debt work. Our roadmap includes Branch Rules, Codeowners, merge strategy options, and artificial intelligence-powered repository management and configuration.

Make a difference by helping students overcome barriers to learning and achieve their full potential through personalised support, encouragement, and care. 

We are seeking a dedicated Teaching Assistant Level 1 to join the team at Kingsmead Academy. Working as part of a small, supportive team under the guidance of the SENDCO, you will play a vital role in supporting students with a wide range of learning, communication, and social needs. 

In this role, you will provide care and supervision for students both within the classroom and across the wider school environment. You will work closely with teaching staff to prepare learning resources, maintain a safe and engaging learning environment, and support the delivery of learning activities that enable all students to access the curriculum. You will adapt your approach to meet the needs of students with significantly varying abilities, ensuring appropriate differentiation and inclusion at all times. 

You will promote positive behaviour, independence, self-esteem, and resilience, helping students to develop the confidence and skills needed to succeed both academically and personally. Working collaboratively with colleagues, you will contribute to creating a supportive and nurturing environment where every student is encouraged to thrive and reach their full potential. 

About you:   

You will: 

  • Have a keen interest in working with children and a genuine commitment to inclusion, ensuring every student feels valued, supported and able to succeed. 
  • Understand the role of a Teaching Assistant and how effective support enables students to access learning, make progress and achieve their potential. 
  • Be able to build positive relationships with students, demonstrating patience, empathy and active listening. 
  • Be confident supporting students on a one-to-one basis and in small groups, using appropriate strategies to engage learners and promote positive behaviour. 
  • Have strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with colleagues, parents/carers and other professionals. 
  • Be adaptable and responsive to the varying needs of students, including those with SEND and additional learning needs. 
  • Have good organisational skills and be able to assist in the preparation of learning activities, resources and support materials. 
  • Work collaboratively as part of a team, contributing positively to student outcomes and the wider school community. 
  • Demonstrate good literacy and numeracy skills and be confident using IT to support learning and administrative tasks. 
  • Be committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare, safety and well-being of children and young people. 
  • Maintain professionalism, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive information. 
  • Be committed to continuous professional development, including undertaking relevant training and qualifications where appropriate. 
  • Be flexible, resilient and able to remain calm under pressure while supporting students with a wide range of needs. 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application.   

About Kingsmead Academy:   

Kingsmead School is a rural mixed ability Academy with a fully comprehensive intake situated near the Devon/Somerset border, close to the Brendon Hills and Exmoor. It is a magnificent area in which to live and work. Not only is there the tranquillity and beauty of the countryside but there is the rapidly growing county town of Taunton nearby and easy access (20 minutes) to the M5 for connections to the rest of the country.   

The school lies in the small town of Wiveliscombe. It caters for the age range 11-16 and has 884 students and just over 100 staff. Our latest Ofsted Report, in June 2022, gave an overall judgement that Kingsmead “requires improvement”. Mr J Eddy, Headteacher, joined Kingsmead in January 2023. He is determined to improve education at Kingsmead for our superb body of students.   

The core values of Kingsmead are Care, Aspiration, Respect and Determination which drive our strong positive ethos and offering amenities for the whole school community. We have high expectations and expect staff to support our caring, student-centred ethos to set high standards for our students. We hope staff will contribute to and lead some of the wide range of extra-curricular opportunities we offer.   

Why work at CLF?   

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered.

  • Generous annual leave. 
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities. 
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme. 
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs. 
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay. 
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking plus many more!

title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

 Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI

 REMOTE, United States

 JOB OVERVIEW

 Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it.

 Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there.

 You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily.

 RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

 Agent definition. Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it.

 Problem selection. The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not.

 The human-in-the-loop contract. Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. Legion treats this as a first-class design problem.

 Build quality. You are accountable for what ships, not for what was specified. That means staying engaged through implementation: reviewing the build against the specification as it comes together, using the product yourself before anyone else is asked to, joining bug triage and design review, catching drift from intent while it is still cheap to correct, and holding a release when the quality is not there. Our customers experience the build, not the document. A well-written specification that produced a product managers do not trust is failed product work, and we assess it that way.

 Evaluation. Build and maintain the evaluation sets that determine whether an agent is ready to ship and whether it is degrading in production — writing the cases, reviewing failure traces, setting the pass criteria. You will be the person who holds a release when the demonstration is persuasive and the evaluation is not.

 Specifications. Legion uses Functional Requirements Documents as its ground-truth specification layer; release notes, enablement material, and sales content are generated from maintained specifications rather than reconstructed from code or institutional memory. Write FRDs that meet that standard and keep them accurate after release. A specification is where the work begins, not where your responsibility ends.

 Commercialization. Partner with go-to-market on packaging, metering, pricing inputs, and field readiness. Agentic products raise difficult commercial questions — what unit to meter, what a customer is paying for when software performs work a person previously did — and you will be expected to hold a considered position on them.

 Design-partner delivery. Lead agent deployments with large enterprise design partners: scoping the pilot, establishing success criteria before it begins, joining failure reviews, and determining what becomes generally available and what remains bespoke.

 TECHNICAL EXPECTATIONS

 Legion is looking for a product manager who builds, rather than one who directs others who build. In a typical week, this role involves:

• Writing and iterating on prompts and system prompts directly, and explaining why a change improved a behavior

• Standing up a working prototype of a proposed agent — tool definitions, structured outputs, retries, guardrails — before engineering is asked to build anything

• Using agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent) daily: prototyping, data analysis, specification work, and reading the codebase behind your specifications

• Reviewing an execution trace and diagnosing whether a failure originates in a tool description, a retrieval gap, a context-window constraint, an under-specified output schema, or a genuine model limitation

• Building and running evaluation sets, and interpreting the results without a data scientist to translate them

• Holding an informed position on retrieval design, tool-use patterns, structured output, model routing, latency and cost trade-offs, and multi-tenant safety in enterprise SaaS

• Opening pull requests against our codebase — a prototype, a prompt change, an evaluation fixture, a specification stub. Pushing code is permitted and actively encouraged for product managers who want to work that way. It is not a requirement of the role, and the same review standards apply to everyone.

• Following model releases, agent frameworks, and protocol changes, and translating them into roadmap implications within days rather than quarters

 We recognize that this is a demanding technical bar for a product role. It reflects what the work actually requires.

 REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years in product management (Senior) or 10+ years (Principal), including at least 2 years shipping LLM-backed features to external, paying users — not internal tools, proofs of concept, or hackathon projects

• Demonstrated hands-on capability of the kind described above. Expect to show your work.

• Substantial enterprise B2B SaaS experience: multi-tenant architecture, role-based access control, audit trails, single sign-on, data residency, security review, and enterprise procurement. You should be able to anticipate what a customer's security questionnaire will ask about an LLM feature.

• A record of taking an ambiguous, operationally complex domain problem through to a shipped product with demonstrated adoption — not only launch

• Evidence of staying with a product through implementation and owning its quality at release. We will ask about a release you delayed or stopped, what you found, and how you found it.

• The judgment to recognize what current models cannot do reliably, and the willingness to say so when a room expects a different answer

• Comfort working inside a codebase. An engineering background is not required, but you should be able to read the code behind what you are specifying, run it locally, and open a pull request.

• Strong written communication. Legion runs on documents, and candidates are evaluated substantially on how they write.

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

• Direct experience in workforce management, HCM, ERP, supply chain, or another operationally complex enterprise domain with compliance exposure

• Familiarity with labor compliance regimes — predictive scheduling ordinances, meal and rest break rules, union work rules — or demonstrated ability to become fluent in a comparable regulatory domain quickly

• Background in demand forecasting, optimization, or decision systems

• Experience building platform or authoring surfaces that customers configure themselves

• An engineering or technical degree, or prior experience as an engineer or data scientist

• Experience with products sold into frontline-heavy industries: retail, hospitality, healthcare, or manufacturing

 SCOPE OF ROLE, STATED PLAINLY

 So that candidates can assess fit early:

• This is an individual contributor role. There is no team to inherit and no management responsibility at present.

• The role is accountable for what ships, not for what is specified. Writing the specification is a portion of the work, not the whole of it.

• This is not an AI strategy or vendor-evaluation role. The work is product definition, prototyping, specification, evaluation, and delivery.

• The role requires forming an independent point of view from operational research. Direction will not be handed down in detail.

• The environment carries genuine ambiguity. The category is being defined as we work in it, and model capabilities shift underneath the roadmap.

 SELECTION PROCESS

 Our process includes a practical exercise: a sanitized workforce management problem, for which candidates produce an agent design — scope, tools, failure modes, human-in-the-loop contract, and evaluation plan — together with a working prototype they built themselves, using any model provider they prefer. The exercise is then discussed with the people the candidate would work alongside. We weigh it heavily, and we compensate candidates for the time.

description:
Headquarters: Remote, US

 About Mixpanel

 Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

 The Customer Value Architects team sits inside the revenue organization and owns the connection between what customers buy and what they actually get out of Mixpanel. We turn product usage into measurable business outcomes, working across onboarding, adoption, and renewal to make sure customers see the value they signed up for.

 About the Role

 The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who connects a customer's Mixpanel investment to real outcomes for a defined book of accounts. You'll own the adoption and value plan for each account end to end: understanding why the customer bought Mixpanel, tracking whether they're getting the ROI they expected, and driving the enablement and product usage that gets them there. You'll build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, partner closely with your Account Executive and renewal counterparts, and bring a growing point of view on how customers should think about AI in their product workflows. This role suits someone who can own a project end to end and is ready to start extending their influence beyond their own accounts to the wider team.

 Responsibilities

• Own the value plan for each account in your portfolio, connecting the business problem that led the customer to buy Mixpanel with the outcomes they measure.

• Build relationships with business and technical stakeholders, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to what customers care about most.

• Run discovery on customer priorities and pain points, and turn what you learn into concrete adoption plans and internal updates.

• Partner with your Account Executive on expansion and your renewal counterpart on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that supports both.

• Lead enablement/best practices sessions on dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling to grow how deeply and widely a customer uses Mixpanel.

• Monitor usage and health signals and lead business reviews that surface what's working, deepen adoption, and catch risk early.

• Spot underused features and contracted capabilities, and turn them into clear recommendations for the customer.

• Triage product questions and issues, solving what you can and routing the rest to the right team.

• Build a working point of view on a customer's AI maturity, and use Mixpanel's own AI surface to help them build on their product data.

• Coordinate with GTM, Product, and Engineering on escalations, and share what works with the broader Customer Value Architects team.

 We're Looking For Someone Who Has

• 4 - 6 years of experience in customer success, consulting, or a related field supporting B2B SaaS accounts, or equivalent experience.

• A track record of managing relationships across a range of stakeholders, from business partners to technical teams.

• The ability to translate technical concepts, like data models and product metrics, into terms that land with non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience turning product usage into a clear story about customer outcomes and ROI.

• Comfort building and running adoption plans that tie daily work to a customer's larger goals.

• Hands-on experience with AI or agentic tooling beyond casual use, such as MCP-based workflows or LLM copilots.

• A collaborative approach to working across account teams and internal partners to move plans forward.

• Good judgment for prioritizing which accounts and actions need attention first.

 Bonus Points For

• Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development.

• Experience in a technical advisory or professional services capacity.

• Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling.

• Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.

• One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.

• Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.

• Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.

• Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

 Why choose Mixpanel?

 We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

 Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.

description:

 Joining Collibra’s Professional Services Team

 At Collibra Public Sector, our Professional Services team relies on Federal Solution Architects to deliver on customer expectations for the services we sell, working directly with customer key projects stakeholders throughout the entire customer journey. Ensuring growth, adoption and renewal, Federal Solution Architects act as customer champions, ensuring customers are onboarded and realizing value rapidly.

 Managers, Professional Services at Collibra are responsible for

• Supporting federal customer engagements by delivering mission-aligned architectural design and execution of Collibra products that adhere to Collibra Public Sector’s Delivery Models, Engagement Processes, Methodologies, and Artifacts, while ensuring compliance with applicable government regulations and security standards (e.g., FedRAMP, FISMA, GovCloud).

• Partnering cross-functionally with Collibra Sales, Customer Engineering, Product, Support, and Executive teams to ensure alignment with federal acquisition cycles and stakeholder priorities.

• Identifying opportunities to expand Collibra’s footprint within agencies by aligning product capabilities to evolving agency mandates, modernization efforts, and compliance requirements.

• Meeting or exceeding utilization goals in support of federal client success, long-term program engagement, and repeatable delivery excellence.

• Contributing to the growth of Collibra’s public sector services and licensing business through account expansion, strategic planning, and customer advocacy.

 You have

• 5-10 years of consulting experience supporting U.S. federal agencies with knowledge in the areas of Data Governance, Data Management or Data Quality.

• An understanding of the leading PaaS providers, Data Lakes, Databases, and Integration platforms commonly adopted by federal agencies.

• A minimum of 2 years of experience working with cloud platforms, network-based API integration (REST/JSON), and deployment automation.

• Skilled in developing functional and technical specifications.

• Experienced with Collibra or comparable technologies.

• Because this role supports the U.S. government business, it is required that this candidate be a U.S. citizen who resides on U.S. soil and holds active security clearance (Secret/TS/TS-SCI).

 You are

• Preferably located in the Washington, D.C. metro area to support in-person federal customer engagements, with an on-site requirement of up to 50%.

• An effective communicator across business and technical stakeholders and able to tailor to different audiences.

• Always customer-focused and personally hold yourself accountable for the customer’s success.

• Build playbooks to address process gaps and inefficiencies within the services organization.

title: Implementation Consultant
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Implementation Consultants start the customers journey after signature working with our top customers. They own the customer relationship and are responsible for a successful deployment of Samsara’s solution. You understand the value they are trying to achieve and work with them to define and deliver a project plan to achieve this.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

Will require travel to customer sites for up to 30% of the time, which may include overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be the Samsara advisor, managing the deployment of Samsara technology to customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment
  • Lead solution workshops to develop L1 processes for business process
  • Guide customers through change management processes including policy, comms and training
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through obstacles with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2+ years of experience in an implementation consultant, project manager, or onboarding role. Enterprise SaaS and hardware experience preferred
  • Strong project management skills with ability to follow methodologies
  • 2+ years experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving & project management skills
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end-to-end system implementations
  • Experience managing >20 implementations/projects at a time
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering senior management, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Fluency in English and German (spoken and written) is a mandatory requirement for this position

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Change management delivery experience
  • Experience using AI or automation into CS workflows to drive measurable productivity improvements.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Controls Product Senior Manager
description:
We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London/Cardiff/UK Remote | £85,000 - £115,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

This role sits at the heart of our Control Discipline change agenda, building the controls product platform that powers safe growth at Monzo.

At Monzo, we don’t treat risk and controls as a bureaucratic governance process. We treat our control framework, tools, and data pipelines as an internal product - designed to give engineers, product managers, and business leads the ability to ship fast - and safely.

We are looking for a Senior Controls Product Manager to join our newly established Controls Product & Enablement team within our Controls Discipline. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering, you will act as the Product Lead for Monzo’s core risk lifecycles (Issues, RCSAs, Controls, Policy, Reg Traceability).

You won't just write requirement docs for someone else to build - you are a builder yourself. You’ll prototype low-code tools, leverage AI models, interrogate data pipelines, and architect automated workflows to turn manual risk friction into seamless, automated self-service.

⭐ Our Controls team

The role will sit within the Controls Product & Enablement team which is part of the wider Controls Discipline in Monzo’s 1st line of defence Our teams work closely with cross-functional teams across the organisation including Technology, Data, Product, Operations as well and Risk & Compliance (the 2nd line of defence).

As this is a newly established team (wherein you’ll have two direct reports already working in the team as data and automation specialists), this role holder needs to bring a flexible and adaptable mindset, as well as a willingness to deal with ambiguity as the team establishes its operating rhythm and embeds itself within the wider business.

What you’ll do (Your Product Ownership Scope)…

  • Own the Controls Product Roadmap: Define the vision, strategy, and backlog for Monzo’s internal risk products, replacing static, manual cycles with smart, data-driven platforms (SmartSuite, Zango, Looker, and native AI integrations).
  • Hands-on Prototyping & Automation: Directly design, prototype, and build automated workflows, API integrations, and low-code/no-code solutions. You'll take an idea from a problem statement to a working MVP before partnering with core Engineering (if necessary) to scale or industrialise it.
  • Pioneer AI in Risk Management: Champion AI adoption across the discipline. Experiment with LLM prompting, custom agents, and automated evidence-gathering tools to solve complex control problems and dramatically reduce manual drag for Monzo staff.
  • Build for Real-Time Risk Intelligence: Drive the shift from annual "point-in-time" assessments to continuous, automated monitoring. Design data triggers (e.g., incident spikes, change flags) that alert risk owners in real time.
  • Product Enablement & Adoption: Ensure high-impact adoption. Work closely with first line risk owners and Risk Partners to deliver clear "write once" guidance, intuitive UI/UX workflows, and enablement that allows teams to self-serve effortlessly.
  • Drive Execution & Delivery: Maintain momentum across the team’s delivery plan (guiding 2 specialised data/automation direct reports), keeping senior stakeholders engaged and removing blockers without bureaucratic overhead.

We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You think like a Product Manager: You obsess over user problems, value vs. effort prioritization, user experience, and shipping MVPs quickly.
  • You are a Hands-On Builder: You can get under the hood with data and automation. You're comfortable with SQL, Python (or similar), APIs, workflow tools, or low-code environments to build a working prototype yourself.
  • You’re AI-Curious & Practical: You actively experiment with AI/LLMs to automate manual tasks and make workflows smarter.
  • You Understand Risk & Controls: You understand fundamental risk concepts (control design, RCSAs, issue management) and see the massive opportunity to transform them through tech.
  • You Thrive in Ambiguity: You enjoy starting from first principles in a fast-paced environment and turning messy operational problems into slick, scalable digital solutions.
  • You have experience in leading teams through change programmes, ideally within Financial Services Controls functions.
  • You are hands-on and take satisfaction in supporting colleagues, projects or tasks however big or small - and can take a range of stakeholders on the journey with you
  • You’re excited by what we’re doing at Monzo

ℹ️ This role isn’t for you if…

  • Your technology and data experience has primarily involved defining requirements for Data or Engineering teams to build, rather than building solutions yourself.
  • You aren't comfortable getting hands-on with data, automation tooling and technical problem solving.
  • You aren’t comfortable with ambiguity, or thinking from first principles
  • You don’t enjoy working in a fast-paced environment
  • You aren’t happy taking an MVP approach and doing what’s good enough for now with iterative changes to follow
  • Equally, if your experience is primarily technical and you don't have sufficient understanding of risk and controls to translate control problems into effective solutions, this role is unlikely to be the right fit.

What’s in it for you

£85,000 - £115,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.


The application journey has 3 key steps

  • Short call with a Monzo Recruiter
  • Video-call with Hiring Manager (30 mins)
  • Full-Loop: 3 x video-call interviews (covering Technical, Behaviours, and Leadership)

This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

⏳We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.


#LI-REMOTE
#CM-1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage
