title: Engineering Manager - Observability | UK | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are considering candidates in Germany, Sweden, Spain, Ireland and the UK only.

The opportunity:

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it.

What is the Ingest team?

We build and maintain the configuration and deployment tooling that bridges the gap between "I want observability" and "I have observability,". To achieve this the team owns Fleet Management, the Kubernetes Monitoring Helm Chart, and the Instrumentation Hub. Fleet Management is the cloud-based central control plane our customers use to manage hundreds of thousands of Observability Collectors in the wild. The Kubernetes Monitoring Helm Chart is used to effectively deploy Observability Collection in Kubernetes based environments. The Instrumentation Hub seamlessly combines Fleet Management and the Kubernetes Monitoring Helm Chart to achieve a magic 1-command instrumentation experience.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Manage and develop the team of backend and frontend engineers, providing regular feedback and supporting each person’s growth through career conversations. This is a remote team, distributed between EMEA and NASA.
  • Collaborate closely with go-to-market to ensure customers and prospects are successful with their Observability collection journey.
  • Work closely with product and engineering leadership to ensure Fleet Management, the Kubernetes Helm Chart, and the Instrumentation Hub fit seamlessly into the end-to-end user experience for Grafana cloud products.
  • Provide guidance throughout the project lifecycle from early ideation through planning, execution and post‑launch guiding the team to deliver high‑quality results consistently.
  • Foster a psychologically safe environment where engineers can learn, experiment and iterate quickly, encouraging innovation and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Work across team boundaries by contributing to projects outside your team’s scope and partnering with other functions to solve customer problems.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Experience in either of these areas is a strong advantage: Observability (especially OpenTelemetry), or building a central control plane that manages fleets of collectors.
  • You will be comfortable working with engineering teams who have a strong sense of autonomy in their decision-making, be it technical or product focused.
  • While you’re great with people and adept at managing relationships, you still keep up-to-date with the latest technical trends and shifts in order to maintain and enhance your understanding of the challenges your teams face.
  • Comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, empathetic communication to build trust, connection, and psychological safety.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complexity, align stakeholders, and elevate team performance to deliver meaningful, high-quality results.
  • Deeply customer-focused, consistently grounding decisions and technical choices in user needs and real-world impact.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, including scalability, fault tolerance, consistency, and observability.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools and ideally have practical experience folding them into a team’s workflow.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 103,000 - GBP 129,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

description:
Headquarters: Remote - California; Remote - Colorado; Remote - Illinois; Remote - Massachusetts; Remote - New York; Remote - Oregon; Remote - Texas; Remote - Washington

 At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform with Startup and Emerging Enterprise customers. You will also help ensure customer success by helping our most complex customers maximize the value they get out of our platform and their return on investment.

 This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases by leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. It is technical in the sense that you will serve as the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels within an organization. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.

 The impact you will have:

• Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritized customers

• Lead the post-technical-win account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts

• Be the accountable technical leader for specific use cases and customers across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, go-live, and healthy consumption of the workloads the customer has chosen to run on Databricks

• Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, often spanning multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations

• Leverage Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services, and Support resources, and escalate to subject matter experts when work falls beyond your scope or expertise

• Create, own, and execute a point of view on how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals

• Partner with Databricks Product and Engineering teams on new product innovations, private previews, and upgrades

• Develop an execution plan spanning all customer-facing technical roles and teams across the following work streams:

• Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production

• Enablement / user growth plan

• Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)

• Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)

• Executive and operational governance

• Provide internal and external updates to your Technical GM — KPI reporting on usage and customer health, covering investment status, key risks, product adoption, and use case progression

 What we look for:

• 5+ years of experience accountable for technical project / program delivery in Data and AI, with the ability to contribute to technical debate and design choices alongside customers

• Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala

• Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role

• Understanding of solution architecture for distributed data systems

• Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverable

• Technical program or project management, including accountability for accounts, stakeholders, and resources

• Experience resolving complex, high-stakes escalations with senior customer executives

• Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis, and managing delivery of complex programs/projects

• Track record of overachievement against quota, goals, or similar objective targets

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote - Canada

 What You Will Do

 We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of the Lattice MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and the integrations that power Lattice AI. This is the connective layer that lets customers use Lattice performance data inside the AI tools they already work in (Claude, ChatGPT, Glean, Microsoft Copilot, and Slack), and that brings third-party productivity data (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Linear, Zoom, Asana) into Lattice. As AI becomes the center of gravity for how companies work, this surface is how Lattice stays connected, interoperable, and indispensable. You’ll join a fully staffed engineering team ready to execute, and together you’ll make ecosystem interoperability a reason customers choose and stay with Lattice.

 If you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping platform strategy, and working with great internal and external partners, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for MCP & AI Ecosystem, you will:

• Own the MCP and AI ecosystem strategy. Not only decide what features and integrations to pursue, but what MCP and AI mean to Lattice and our customers. Become a thought leader on how AI should shape HR for the better.

• Ship integrations that create leverage. Deliver new MCP tools, resources, and third-party connectors that expand what admins, managers, and executives can do with Lattice data in the flow of work.

• Build durable foundations, like authentication, agentic execution frameworks, and evals that make future integrations faster, more scalable, and easier to adopt and maintain.

• Be a technical thought partner to Engineering. Help shape technical direction on MCP tool design and third party integration infrastructure, translating complex constraints into clear product decisions.

• Drive go-to-market with partners. Partner with Partnerships, Product Marketing, to launch integrations that deliver measurable customer and ecosystem impact.

• Own outcomes. Influence and own key results across integration and MCP adoption, reliability, activation, and ecosystem growth.

 What You Will Bring to the Table

 We’re looking for a seasoned product manager with the technical depth and strategic instincts to shape Lattice’s next generation of integrations and APIs. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of:

• 6+ years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of integrations, platform, or ecosystem surfaces (built end-to-end, not just configured).

• Direct experience building technical integrations in a multi-party ecosystem — for example ad technology / marketing technology, marketplaces, developer platforms, payments, data connectivity, or similar — where partnership strategy shaped what you built.

• Strong technical fluency: comfortable with third-party integration patterns, data sync and field mapping, webhooks, and auth/OAuth; you can hold a credible architecture conversation with engineers and partner CTOs.

• A track record of shipping scalable, reliable integrations in partnership with engineering, and of standing up partner or marketplace launches with go-to-market teams.

• Evidence of turning a platform or ecosystem into a competitive advantage — a reason customers chose your product, not just a checkbox.

• Clear, confident communication that brings internal teams and external partners into alignment.

• A bias for action and the ability to create structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving space.

 Bonus:

• Exposure to AI ecosystems, MCP, AI agents, or LLM tooling (helpful, not required).

• Experience in multi-product B2B SaaS, or with HR/people-data or other sensitive-data workflows.

 If you have strong experience with integrations, APIs, or platform products, even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification, we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for strong product thinkers with deep technical fluency, not perfect resumes.

 Location Requirement:
This role is open to candidates located in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada. At this time, we are only able to hire employees residing in these provinces.

 __

 The estimated annual cash salary for this role is CAD $135,000 - $180,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans.

 Benefits: Lattice offers eligible Canada-based employees comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability coverage; mental health and wellness support; emergency weather support; 16 weeks of paid parental leave; flexible time off, 13 company holidays, and 3 recharge days; a monthly remote-work stipend and one-time home-office setup stipend; an RRSP contribution match of up to 3% of gross pay (maximum $2,500 CAD annually); and a $500 CAD annual Learning & Development reimbursement. Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements.

 *Note on Pay Transparency:

 Lattice provides an estimate of the compensation for roles that may be hired as required by state regulations. Compensation may vary based on (a) location, as Lattice factors in specific location when benchmarking compensation for most roles; (b) individual candidate skills and qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience.

 Additionally, Lattice leverages current market data to determine compensation, so posted compensation figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Lattice reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

 Lattice is on a mission to build cultures where employees and their companies thrive. In an age where employees have more choices than ever before, businesses that put employees first are winning – and Lattice is building the tools to empower those people-centric companies.

 Lattice is a people success platform that offers performance reviews, employee engagement surveys, real-time feedback, weekly check-ins, goal setting, and career planning in a way that allows companies to focus on employee development, growth, and engagement – yielding stronger employee retention, performance, and impact to the bottom line . Since launching in 2016, we have grown to over 5,000+ customers globally, including brands like Loom, Robinhood, and Gusto.

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

 The Community You Will Join:

 The Senior Quality Lead, Volume Tiers is the single accountable leader for quality measurement, insights, and continuous improvement across Airbnb's highest-volume Community Support functions. This role owns the end-to-end quality program for:

• Global English (GE)

• Rest of World (ROW; which is comprised of 9 different languages)

• Elevated Support

 GE and ROW span across multiple service tiers: Resolutions 1, 2, and 3, Dedicated Service Support (DSS), Dedicated Managed Host Support (DMHS); supported across a global partner network operating 24/7 in dozens of languages.

 The Difference You will Make:

 This is a senior leadership role operating at the intersection of strategy and execution. The Senior Quality Lead will break down silos within the Quality organization, establish a unified operating model, and leverage AI-powered tools to scale quality insights. This leader will work closely with Service Delivery, Training, Business Process Improvement, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, remediate issues, and ensure Airbnb is providing its global partner network a unified set of priorities.

 The successful candidate will establish themselves as a credible partner to stakeholders and be recognized internally as the voice of quality for the Volume Tier portfolio.

 A Typical Day:

 Strategic Leadership & Program Ownership

• Own and execute the Volume Tier quality strategy aligned to several critical priorities: breaking silos, aligning with stakeholders, defining a clear operating model, and driving measurable impact.

• Consolidate fragmented QA frameworks across GE and ROW into a unified operating model, eliminating inconsistent processes, divergent NPS detractor approaches, and incompatible quality signals.

• Represent Volume Tier quality in WBRs, MBRs, QBRs, and cross-functional planning forums; bring a proactive, narrative-led perspective that gives leadership visibility before problems surface in operational reviews.

 Measurement & Quality Execution

• Oversee QA evaluation execution across all Volume Tier partner sites globally, ensuring consistent application of QA processes and frameworks.

• Lead root cause analysis on systemic failures, translating QA findings into product, process, and policy recommendations that go beyond agent-level coaching.

• Formalize Audit the Auditor as an ongoing control: define sample selection, alignment thresholds, root cause review, and evaluator-level remediation processes.

• Ensure every evaluation closes with a documented coaching action; build the tracking mechanisms to measure whether coaching is translating into performance improvement over time.

 Insights, Reporting & Stakeholder Partnership

• Establish automated KPI reporting across all Volume Tier sites, tiers, and languages, eliminating manual processes.

• Unify NPS detractor analysis across GE and ROW, ensuring global patterns surface in real time.

• Build a Partner QA Performance Scorecard, establishing clear accountability for Calibration Accuracy, Evaluation Completeness, Critical Error Detection, Coaching Effectiveness.

 AI & Technology Enablement

• Lead the deployment of AutoQA (via Observe.AI) across Volume Tiers; partner with the Platform team to ensure appropriate sequencing.

• Build and govern a clear accountability framework for AI-assisted quality tools and processes.

 People & Culture Leadership

• Lead a globally distributed team of Partner Quality Leads and Quality Insights Analysts.

• Foster a One-Quality-Team culture that eliminates the cross-team divides: shared best practices, cross-regional learning, and proactive knowledge sharing.

• Set high expectations and hold the team accountable for output quality, insight delivery, and stakeholder engagement.

• Partner closely with peers to ensure one consistent quality voice across the portfolio.

 Your Expertise:

• 12+ years of experience in Customer/Community Support, Quality Assurance, or Contact Center Operations, with direct accountability for large-scale, multilingual QA programs.

• 5+ years managing globally distributed QA teams across multiple languages, regions, and partner organizations in a 24/7 support environment.

• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience, preferably in related field; MBA or Masters preferred

• Experience with QA tooling platforms, including hands-on ownership of form design, calibration management, and AutoQA deployment.

• Deep expertise in quality methodologies (COPC, AQS, Six Sigma, Lean), with a proven ability to apply them to high-volume, complex support environments.

• Demonstrated track record of leading quality transformation, consolidating fragmented programs, driving measurable improvement in NPS/CSAT, and QA calibrations.

• Experience deploying or scaling AI/ML assisted QA tools (AutoQA, predictive NPS/CSAT).

• Strong executive presence: able to influence senior stakeholders, present a unified quality narrative in leadership forums, and drive alignment across stakeholders.

• Experience managing vendor partner governance: calibration oversight, performance improvement plans, and escalation frameworks.

 Preferred

• COPC certification; Six Sigma Green or Black Belt.

• Experience with Observe.AI.

• Background in program management, change management, or organizational design within a high-growth tech environment.

• Experience working in or closely with BPO/vendor governance models at scale (1,000+ partner FTEs across multiple sites and geographies).

 Your Location:

 This position is Canada - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a province where Airbnb Canada, Inc. has a registered entity. Currently we can hire in the following provinces: Ontario, British Columbia, Quebec, Alberta, and Saskatchewan. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with your recruiter on what provinces you are eligible to work from.

title: VP, Finance
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://engine.com/

 About the Role

 We're looking for a VP, Finance to lead Finance at Engine and serve as a strategic partner to our CEO and executive leadership team.

 You'll own the financial strategy and operating cadence of the company, from planning and forecasting to capital allocation, business performance, financial reporting, and long-range strategy. You'll help leadership understand what is driving the business, where we should invest, and what we need to do next. You'll also be the architect of Engine's financial story, shaping how the company is understood by its Board, investors, and partners.

 You'll build the Finance organization and infrastructure to support Engine through its next phase of growth. That means creating clarity where there is ambiguity, building scalable processes before they become bottlenecks, and using data, systems, and AI to make Finance increasingly leveraged.

 Success in this role will be measured by business impact and the results of the Finance organization.

 What You'll Do

 Strategic Financial Leadership

• Serve as the CEO's financial thought partner on growth strategy, investment priorities, resource allocation, and profitability. Drive capital allocation decisions across the executive team — where Engine invests people, capital, and resources, and where we make tradeoffs. Bring financial rigor to pricing, monetization, new products, markets, and partnerships.

 Capital Strategy & Transactions

• Own fundraising, debt and liquidity strategy, M&A, and other strategic transactions. Build investor relationships, lead the Board story on performance, and prepare Engine for future capital events — including the reporting, controls, and governance a public-ready company requires (SOX readiness, audit committee partnership, external guidance frameworks).

 Financial Planning & Business Insight

• Own the financial plan — quarterly forecasting, long-range modeling, scenario analysis, and the operating cadence across Engine. Develop a deep understanding of revenue, margins, customer economics, pricing, payment economics, and cash flow. Build the metrics and frameworks that make the business legible to leadership.

 Narrative & Communication

• Tell Engine's financial story to the Board, investors, lenders, and partners — turning complex numbers into a narrative leadership can act on and external audiences believe. Lead financial reporting and help the CEO communicate performance, outlook, risks, opportunities, and key decisions with clarity.

 Build Finance for Scale

• Build and lead a high-performance Finance team — attracting exceptional talent, modernizing through AI and automation, and establishing systems, processes, data infrastructure, and controls that scale without creating bureaucracy. Partner with Accounting, Treasury, Legal, and external advisors to ensure Engine has the financial foundation required to scale responsibly.

 What You'll Bring

 Experience and Background

• 12+ years of experience across investment banking, private equity, growth equity, corporate finance, FP&A, strategic finance, or a related field, with significant experience in high-growth technology.

• Investment banking or private equity background, with hands-on experience in valuation, transaction execution, and capital markets. Strongly preferred.

• Experience leading Finance, or a major component of Finance, at a high-growth tech, SaaS, marketplace, fintech, or similarly complex company.

 Financial Expertise

• Exceptional financial modeling skills and a strong understanding of three-statement modeling, unit economics, cash flow, and capital allocation.

• A track record of building financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytical infrastructure in environments that are scaling quickly.

• Experience evaluating pricing, monetization, new products, investments, headcount, and other strategic decisions.

 Communication and Partnership

• A track record of communicating complex financial stories to investors, boards, and executive teams in ways that drive decisions and build confidence.

• Experience partnering directly with a CEO, executive team, and Board.

 Leadership and Team Building

• Experience building and developing high-performing Finance teams. Comfort operating without a fully defined playbook and building structure where it doesn’t exist.

 Judgment and Execution

• Strong commercial instincts. You understand that Finance exists to help the business make better decisions, not simply to explain what happened last quarter.

• The ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical level and an usually high bar for execution and bias towards action

• Strong conviction and judgment. You bring a point of view vs just presenting options.

 Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

 Base Pay Range

 $300,000 - $375,000 USD

 The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

• Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.

• Benefits: Check out our full list at engine.com/culture

• Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

 Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

description:
Headquarters: Remote US

 What We Do:

 Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

 Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

 Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

 Reports to: SDR Manager

 Location: Remote US

 Compensation Range: $58,500 base with on target earnings at $78,000 plus equity

 What You'll Do:

 Huntress is looking for a talented and passionate Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help fuel our continued growth. In this role, you will open doors for the Account Executive team by building relationships with managed service providers (MSPs) and managed security service providers (MSSPs), earning trust quickly, and turning early conversations into qualified meetings that move the pipeline forward. You are outcome-obsessed in how you work, with a clear eye on the right next step, the right partner fit, and the follow-through it takes to create real pipeline impact.

 In the daily rhythm of prospecting into the MSP and MSSP space, you bring warrior spirit. You stay steady through rejection, keep your standards high, and come back sharper on the next call. You also give a sh*t about the people on the other end of the phone, leading with honesty, curiosity, and respect as you help prospective partners understand the value Huntress can deliver to their business and their customers.

 Responsibilities:

• Establish rapport and trust with managed service provider (MSP) and managed security service provider (MSSP) prospects via phone, email, and LinkedIn to understand their business and their fit with Huntress.

• Research accounts, document prospecting activity, and qualification notes in CRM, and maintain strong data hygiene.

• Use AI tools with good judgment to support account research, call prep, and message drafting in your day-to-day work.

• Keep improving your cold calling, messaging, and pipeline management skills through training, feedback, and repetition.

 What You Bring to the Team:

• 8+ months of experience in a quota-carrying outbound B2B SaaS sales role.

• Experience with outbound cold calling.

• Strong time management and the ability to prioritize competing tasks.

• Comfort working across CRM, prospecting tools, and multiple systems at the same time.

• Attention to detail when taking notes, setting meetings, and following the process.

• A coachable mindset and a genuine interest in continuing to grow your sales and cybersecurity knowledge.

• Curiosity about AI and the judgment to use it in practical ways that help you work faster and smarter in your day-to-day.

 What We Offer:

• 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015

• Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays

• Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans

description:
Privacy Compliance Associate - Glasgow

We are seeking a Privacy Compliance Associate to join our Data Governance & AI Non-Financial Risk team, supporting Morgan Stanley in meeting its privacy and data protection obligations. The role will work across business lines to help ensure global Data Subject Rights requests, including access and erasure requests, are managed appropriately and responded to within required timeframes.

In the Legal & Compliance division, we assist the Firm in achieving its business objectives by facilitating and overseeing the Firm's management of legal, regulatory and franchise risk. This is an Associate level position within the Privacy Non-Financial Risk (NFR) team who are part of the second line of defence, governing and overseeing data subject rights requests and privacy across the Firm.

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

What you'll do in the role:

- Assist Privacy NFR to support colleagues and partners across the Firm when responding to Data Subject Rights requests, including data subject access requests (DSARs) and erasure requests, within statutory deadlines.

- Assist Privacy NFR to support colleagues and partners across the Firm with the intake, processing, redactions and quality assurance checks of request responses.

- Support Privacy NFR with oversight activity including monitoring of dashboards and production of metrics for reporting to colleagues, partners and governance groups.

- Support Privacy NFR by providing advice and guidance on global Data Subject Rights to key stakeholders across the Firm.

- Enhance policies, procedures, processes, reporting, training and support ad-hoc projects as required.

What you'll bring to the role:

- Ability to collaborate and partner with cross-functional teams, business units and individuals at all levels.

- Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks and manage deadlines.

- Proactive work ethic and team player mindset.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- A passion for data protection and privacy.

- A willingness to learn and develop.

- Experience with One Trust Privacy Automation/ DSAR tool or similar is preferred.

At least 2 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role.

This Role is unable to offer Sponsorship.

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients - helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that's differentiated - and we've done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren't just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. We are looking for someone who can start from an ambiguous problem, no defined path, and competing priorities, and work through that to frame the problem, align stakeholders on what matters most, and move quickly from idea to working prototype to a shipped experience.   • A bias toward ownership, execution, and continuous improvement, with the judgment to prioritize the highest-leverage work across the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android architecture patterns. Experience with Kotlin coroutines, and dependency injection frameworks (e.g. Metro, Dagger).
  • Experience leading large-scale new products, features, or product transformations spanning multiple teams or the whole org.
  • Experience using research, usability testing, data, and experimentation to ground decisions and uncover opportunities.
  • Contributions to open source projects or the Android community, or other external recognition of technical leadership.
  • Experience building collaboration, productivity, messaging, AI, or enterprise software products.
  • Excellent communication skills.

Unleash Your Potential

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. title: Analyst
description:
Headquarters: Remote US

 At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 About the Risk & Analytics Team

 The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

 Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

 We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

 One Role, Multiple Teams

 We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

 If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

 Potential team placements include:

• Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.

• Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.

• Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.

• Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.

• Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.

• International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.

 About the Role

 As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

 You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

 You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

 What You Will Do

• Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.

• Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.

• Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.

• Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.

• AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.

 What We Look For

• 1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.

• Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

• Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.

• Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.

• Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.

• Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.

 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

 Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

 As a growth-focused Fullstack Engineer on our team, you will play a central role in driving user acquisition, conversion, and retention through highly performant and visually stunning web experiences. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams—from marketing to sales to product design—to build dynamic pages, run A/B tests, and optimize conversion funnels.

By staying updated on industry trends and focusing on delightful UX, you’ll continuously refine our web properties—ultimately delivering an exceptional experience from first touch through ongoing engagement.

If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

 About Faire

 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

 About this role

 As a Recruiter at Faire, you will be instrumental in helping scale a high-growth startup. We are looking for someone that is passionate about recruiting and working with hiring managers to find top talent across our Business orgs. We are looking for someone that has a positive attitude, a proactive approach to managing pipelines and a seamless candidate experience, and can partner effectively with our recruiting team and key stakeholders to grow the company.

 What You'll Do

• Use your talents as a recruiter to manage the full cycle recruiting process, including the ability to negotiate and close candidates

• Communicate and effectively partner with hiring managers to deeply understand roles and build out structured processes and create effective job descriptions

• Drive creative sourcing strategies across multiple channels, along with internal referrals, to identify and attract high quality candidates

• Drive the offer process to onboard candidates

• Help maintain our applicant tracking system to ensure data integrity and build out transparent reporting for stakeholders on recruiting activity

• Be a gatekeeper of our culture and champion for Faire values: We serve our community, We seek the truth, We are all owners, We embrace the adventure, We are kind

• Help build an inclusive and diverse team environment

 Qualifications

• 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally coming from a tech start-up

• You are resourceful, proactive and take initiative on helping to solve complex talent puzzles

• You are passionate about recruiting

• You are organized and have excellent time management skills

• You care deeply about the candidate experience and employee brand, with impeccable attention to detail

• You have excellent communication skills, written and verbal

• You are data driven and have experience managing weekly pipeline reporting

 Salary Range

Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.

 Why you’ll love working at Faire

• Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.

• Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.

• Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.

• Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.

• Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.

 Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. title: Research Data Expert
location: London, United Kingdom, New York, NY, Singapore
description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Research Data Expert to join our Data team. Data is a cornerstone of HRT’s trading strategies, serving as the raw fuel that powers research, automated trading, and risk management.

In this role, you will own a specific area of expertise, working on sourcing junior data engineers, platform engineers, and alpha researchers to build and maintain trading strategies. You will also be responsible for providing fully featurized datasets to statistical modeling researchers.

HRT does not have information siloes. You will be collaborating directly with our researchers and will be responsible for driving  the business forward through rigorous data analysis and delivery. You will also manage the full end-to-end pipeline from vendor downloads to trading-ready data. As an expert in one area, you will mentor junior data engineers, assisting and validating their work, and will partner with our sourcing team to identify optimal opportunities for data procurement. Furthermore, you will be responsible for ensuring high-quality service by implementing rigorous data checks and alerts.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain fully featurized datasets for statistical modeling research
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for a designated data domain
  • Provide technical support and guidance to researchers on vendor data and derived datasets
  • Mentor and direct junior data engineers, including performing code and data output validation
  • Partner with the sourcing team to identify and evaluate new data procurement opportunities
  • Analyze data to identify and improve alpha
  • Manage the full end-to-end data pipeline, from raw vendor ingestion to refined feature sets
  • Provide on-call support for data issues during normal business hours
  • Design and implement automated data quality checks and monitoring alerts

Qualifications

  • Strong programming skills (Python/R preferred) and proficiency in data science methodologies
  • 5+ years of professional experience in a specific data domain (e.g., alternative data, fundamentals, security reference, or economic data)
  • Proven track record of building alpha through detailed data analysis
  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Undergraduate degree in a STEM field

The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

Please be advised: Use of AI tools by an applicant during interviews or assessments is strictly prohibited, unless otherwise instructed or agreed upon. We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used by an applicant during an interview or an assessment, we reserve the right to immediately end the interview or assessment, disqualify the applicant’s candidacy and/or rescind any job offers extended.

You can review our Global Applicant Privacy Notice, which explains how we process applicant information.

title: Senior Developer Educator
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid); U.S. Remote

 Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

 We’re looking for a Senior Developer Educator to help us create best-in-class video, written, and hands-on education content for Webflow customers, and those who want to define the next phases of the web. You’ll present on camera as a developer educator, and, to keep your skills fresh, you’ll build production grade sites using Webflow that we use in our education videos and courses. You’ll also keep your skills fresh by learning how to integrate Webflow with other services and technologies and then develop content demonstrating how.

 About the role:

• Location: San Francisco HQ or Remote (United States)

• Travel required to SF - 1 week per month

• Full-time

• Permanent

• Exempt

• The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.

• United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)

• Zone A: $129,000 - $155,000

• Zone B: $121,500 - $146,000

• Zone C: $113,000 - $136,000

 This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals.

 Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

• Application Information:

• Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled

• This posting is for a new position

• Reporting to the Director, Education Video

 As a Senior Developer Educator you’ll …

• Build the reference websites that anchor Webflow University courses, tutorials, and live training — real, production-quality sites and components that hold up to scrutiny from developers and designers, not just demos that survive a screen recording (see examples in our videos at Webflow University )

• Shape technical curriculum in partnership with instructional designers and video producers , scoping what each lesson needs to demonstrate and why, before anything gets built or shot

• Present technical content on camera for tutorials, course lessons, and live sessions — walking through code and craft with the clarity of someone who actually built the thing

• Work alongside video producers and instructional designers through pre-production, shooting, and review, so what's on screen empowers learners to do the thing

• Serve as the education team's technical subject matter expert , reviewing content for accuracy and pressure-testing it against how people really work and build

• Keep the technical library current as the platform ships, deciding what's gone stale, what needs rebuilding, and what's newly worth teaching

• Partner with product and engineering to understand what's coming, so education is ready when it launches rather than catching up after

 About you:

 Requirements:

• 4+ years of experience in technical education and web development and/or design

• Proficient in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with the ability to write, review, and explain code - leveraging AI tools to accelerate development and refine quality.

• Demonstrated experience teaching technical concepts to a mixed audience through video, documentation, courses, workshops, or community work

• Willingness and ability to present on camera - from an outline or word-for-word script, in studio or from your own home setup

 You’ll thrive as a Senior Technical Educator if you:

• Build things because you need to understand them, not just to ship them

• Can address multiple audiences — the visual developer who's never opened a code editor, the engineer evaluating how Webflow can help them build better, and the marketer who’s been handed off components and templates to build with

• Take feedback on your on-camera work as craft input rather than personal critique

• Enjoy collaborating with technical and less technical education teammates alike, recognizing the unique role each person plays in the success of a project

• Are passionate about learning, education, and helping others succeed

• Are equally confident showing the messy middle of a build or the polished result

• Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact

 Our Core Behaviors:

•
 Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

•
 Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

• Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible

• Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

 Benefits

• Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

• Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

• Support for every stage of family life . 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

• Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

• Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

• Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.

• Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.

• Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

 Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

 Be you, with us

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. description:
PLACEMENT STUDENT - Supply Chain Logistics, Darlington

We are looking for an enthusiastic Supply Chain Logistics Placement Student to join our team specializing in Logistics for our Corporate/CBS Segment in Darlington, UK. During your placement with us, you will learn how a major global organization operates, gaining the tools and exposure you will need to become an expert in the industry.

This role is available to candidates who qualify for a placement year and will commence Summer of 2027.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Support day-to-day transportation and logistics operations for inbound and outbound shipments; assist with the planning, booking, tracking, and monitoring of road, air, ocean, and courier shipments.
  • Liaise with carriers, freight forwarders, warehouses, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to resolve transportation issues and support service delivery; monitor shipment progress and proactively communicate risks, delays, and recovery actions.
  • Support the preparation and validation of shipping documentation, customs documentation, commercial invoices, and transportation paperwork; assist with transportation planning during peak demand periods, plant shutdowns, and operational constraints.
  • Support freight cost control by identifying consolidation opportunities and alternative transportation solutions; participate in carrier performance reviews and support the measurement of service, cost, and compliance metrics.
  • Investigate shipment exceptions, delays, and service failures and support implementation of corrective actions; support continuous improvement projects focused on transportation efficiency, lead time reduction, service improvement, and cost savings.
  • Develop KPI reporting and logistics dashboards to improve operational visibility and decision-making; work collaboratively with Planning, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Customer Support, Shipping, Warehousing, and Trade Compliance teams to support uninterrupted supply chain operations.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Studying towards a degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, Economics, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Strong interest in transportation, logistics, and global supply chain operations; excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment along with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a team.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities; great communication skills and confidence working with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, Access, or similar analytical tools would be beneficial but is not essential.

title: Design Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

 About Vercel:

 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

 Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

 About the Role:

 AI Gateway gives developers one place to connect applications and agents to hundreds of models with one API key. It handles provider routing and fallbacks, unifies billing and observability, and lets teams manage spend and security controls across production AI workloads.

 Designing this well is a systems problem. A developer should be able to choose the right model, make and verify a first request, diagnose a failed request, and configure routing, budgets, credentials, and security controls without losing sight of the application they are trying to build. The right interface might be in the dashboard, on the public model catalog, in the CLI, in an API response, or in code.

 You will be the Design Engineer for AI Gateway, owning product design and frontend implementation across those surfaces. You will work with customers, a Product Manager, and engineers to understand the problem, explore solutions, build the production experience, ship it, and learn from what happens after launch.

 AI Gateway is live, the model ecosystem changes every week, and the team can move from an observed problem to production quickly. This is a rare chance to use your product judgment, design craft, and code to shape a developer product and ship the experience yourself.

 You will be the design owner embedded with a Product Manager and a dedicated engineering team. You will also have the Product Design team around you for critique, collaboration, and support. AI Gateway will be your main product area, with room to pursue design-led improvements across Vercel. You will report to the Design Team.

 If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

 What You Will Do:

• Own product design and frontend implementation for meaningful parts of the journey from discovering a model to making a first successful request and operating AI in production.

• Design and build production experiences across the website, dashboard, CLI, and APIs, choosing the right medium for each problem.

• Make models, providers, credentials, routing, budgets, logs, performance, privacy, and governance understandable, then create patterns that extend across new providers, modalities, and workloads.

• Talk directly with customers and use product data to understand problems, define success, make tradeoffs, and improve what ships.

• Own quality after launch, including visual and interaction craft, accessibility, performance, resilience, instrumentation, and edge cases.

• Use coding agents to explore and implement ideas quickly, while testing, debugging, and taking responsibility for what ships.

 About You:

• Your work shows what you personally identified, designed, built, shipped, and learned after launch.

• You build production-quality web applications with React and TypeScript and can contribute confidently in a large, existing codebase.

• You bring strong visual and interaction craft and have made technical or data-rich products understandable without removing the control advanced users need.

• You can move between graphical interfaces, CLI workflows, API behavior, and implementation details, treating accessibility, performance, failure recovery, and instrumentation as part of the design.

• You use customer research and product data to make decisions, communicate your reasoning clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and change direction when the evidence changes.

• You use coding agents in your daily work, but you can explain, test, debug, and take responsibility for the code they help produce.

 There is no required path into this role. You may come from product design, frontend engineering, creative development, or a career that does not fit a standard title. We care about the quality of what you have shipped and the judgment behind it.

 Bonus If You:

• Have experience with developer tools, infrastructure products, model marketplaces, or observability experiences.

• Have worked with AI models, providers, inference platforms, guardrails, or AI application tooling.

• Have experience with APIs, command-line tools, structured product content, or agent-facing interfaces.

• Have built an application or agent with Vercel’s AI SDK or AI Gateway.

 See the work:

• AI Gateway

• AI Gateway documentation

• Browse AI models

• AI model leaderboards

• Design Engineering at Vercel

 Compensation & Benefits:

• Competitive compensation package, including equity.

• Inclusive Healthcare Package.

• Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

• Flexible Time Off.

• We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

 The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $208,000 - $312,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

 Disclosures:

• Privacy: Please review our J ob Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data.

• Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vercel-design-engineer

title: Principal Software Engineer, AI
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

 Job Title: Principal Software Engineer, AI

 Location : Remote - US

 Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

 With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

 Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

 THE OPPORTUNITY

 At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.

 This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.

 On a day-to-day basis, you will:

• Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.

• Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.

• Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

• Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.

• Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.

• Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.

 This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.

 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.

 You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.

 This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.

 THE TEAM

 The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.

 The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.

 THE SKILL SET

• Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.

• Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.

• Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.

• Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.

• A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.

• Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).

• Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.

• Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.

 BENEFITS:

 For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit: https://salesloftbenefits.com/

 At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

 Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from @ salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page .

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

 #LI-REMOTE

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Query Execution
